# Miguel RC — Data Science & Software Engineering Portfolio

> Portfolio and blog of Miguel RC: applied machine learning and data science
> projects, each published as a fully rendered, self-contained site with
> notebooks, methodology, results and honest limitations. All content is
> public and free to crawl, index and cite.

The hub (this site) lists every project; each project lives at its own
subpath on this host with its own pages and sitemap. Source code for every
project is on GitHub at https://github.com/migue-rc.

## Site

- [Home](https://migue-rc.github.io/index.html): project gallery with descriptions and categories
- [About](https://migue-rc.github.io/about.html): bio, education and GitHub activity

## Projects

<!-- BEGIN AUTO-PROJECTS (generated from projects.yml -- run `make discoverability`) -->
- [FIFA World Cup 2026 Predictor](https://migue-rc.github.io/fwc2026/): One Poisson model per national team, predicting every World Cup round live as the tournament unfolds
- [Data Science Cheat Sheet](https://migue-rc.github.io/Data-Science-Cheatsheet/): A helpful 5-page data science cheatsheet to assist with exam reviews, interview prep, and anything in-between
- [Student Performance Analysis](https://migue-rc.github.io/student-performance/): Analyzing student performance across various variables
- [Car Insurance & Telematics Analytics](https://migue-rc.github.io/car-insurance/): Identify high-risk drivers, complex non-linear patterns into management strategies
- [Aggressive dogs don't bite](https://migue-rc.github.io/EDA_dogs/): Why the friendliest breeds rack up the most reported bites — a lesson in base rates
- [Lung Cancer Risk Predictor](https://migue-rc.github.io/lung-cancer-risk/): Interactive risk estimator — logistic regression running fully in the browser
- [Linear Regression from Scratch](https://migue-rc.github.io/FS-linear-regression/): Explores the underlying math and nuances for this supervised learning algorithm
- [Logistic Regression from Scratch](https://migue-rc.github.io/FS-logistic-regression/): Deep dive on logistic regression, built entirely from scratch with NumPy
<!-- END AUTO-PROJECTS -->
